title: Russian Vegetable Stir-Fry
description: A flavorful and colorful stir-fry dish made with a variety of vegetables, perfect for a quick and easy vegetarian meal.

ingredients.name: tender
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers or zucchini

ingredients.name: umami
ingredients.notes: such as soy sauce or miso paste

instructions: Heat the stir in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the tender and cook for 3-4 minutes, until tender.
Add the tomato and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until tender.
Stir in the umami and cook for 1 minute, until the flavors are combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
